This section documents the fictional thesis as a worked example. Each page answers one question that a real thesis must also answer.

| Page | Question |
| --- | --- |
| [Requirements register](requirements.qmd) | Which rules apply, where do they come from, and which Issue covers them? |
| [Data dictionary](data-dictionary.qmd) | What does each column of the dataset mean, and how can someone reuse it? |
| [Publication note](publication.qmd) | What can be published, where, and what can GitHub not guarantee? |

The planning side of the same thesis is in [Project management](../project-management/backlog.md).

## Maintenance rule

Update the documentation in the same pull request as the data or the plan that it describes.
